title: What gives the scam away?
instruction: Tap every part of the message that gives a scam away: pressure (hurry, fear, reward, trust) or a request for money, a code, a password or logging in through a link. If the message is fine, mark nothing.
debrief: A scam gives itself away by pressure and by what it wants: money, a code, a password or logging in through a link. If you can't check it, stop and check it another way: in the app, at school or on a number you know.

segments.text: for an extra payment of €1.50 customs duty.
segments.why: It wants money. The small amount is meant to look innocent.

segments.text: Without payment it will be returned today.
segments.why: Hurry and fear: “today”, or you lose the parcel.
A strange link. You check a parcel in the courier’s app or on its website that you know.

items.label: E-mail · class teacher, school address
items.why: It wants nothing from you: no link, no details, no hurry. You find the details in the school system you know.

segments.text: Hello, on Friday we are going on a school trip.
We meet at 8:00 in front of the school,
bring a snack and a drink.
You will find the details in the school system.
2,000 gems are waiting for you in a competition.
segments.why: A reward for a competition you know nothing about.
Hurry, so you don't have time to think.

segments.text: by logging in with your game account:
segments.why: It wants you to log in through a link. That’s how accounts get stolen.
A strange address. A real prize would show up right in the game.

segments.text: My phone broke, I’m calling from someone else’s.
segments.why: It explains why the call comes from an unknown number. That is exactly how scams with a voice cloned by AI begin.

segments.text: You’ll get a text with a code, read it out to me,
segments.why: It wants the code. A code from a text message is the key to an account and belongs to nobody else, not even Mum.

items.label: Text message · Game (you are logging in right now)
items.why: The code came because you are logging in right now. It belongs only in the game’s login window.

segments.text: Hey, please vote for me in a competition!
Just log in with your account here:
segments.why: It wants you to log in through a link. A scammer may already control Tomáš’s account.
A strange link, even from a friend. Check with him another way, for example call him.
